body:
_This is a hotfix release for the [2026.10.22](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/releases/tag/2026.10.22) release._

**This release fixes Pwndbg for LLDB, which did not start at all in 2026.10.22 portable builds.** If you installed `pwndbg-lldb` 2026.10.22 (via the install script, Homebrew, or the release packages and tarballs), please upgrade. Pwndbg for GDB was not affected.

It also brings a few fixes to the `spray`, `hexdump` and `try-free` commands.

Thanks to everyone who reported the issue and contributed!

Please [sponsor us at Pwndbg](https://github.com/sponsors/pwndbg) so we can keep improving it! -- We can give you a talk about Pwndbg too!

----

## Quick install

Install Pwndbg portable on Linux or macOS (choose one line for GDB or LLDB):

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf 'https://install.pwndbg.re' | sh -s -- -t pwndbg-gdb
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -LsSf 'https://install.pwndbg.re' | sh -s -- -t pwndbg-lldb
```

Homebrew package (macOS only; choose one line for GDB or LLDB):

```sh
brew install pwndbg/tap/pwndbg-gdb  # only allows for remote debugging of ELFs
brew install pwndbg/tap/pwndbg-lldb
```

Nix package manager (Linux/macOS; choose one line for GDB or LLDB):

```sh
nix shell github:pwndbg/pwndbg  # this is pwndbg-gdb
nix shell github:pwndbg/pwndbg#pwndbg-lldb
```

Other options:

* For distro and architecture packages, see the [setup docs](https://pwndbg.re/stable/setup) and the release assets below.
* For the latest development version, [install from source](https://pwndbg.re/dev/setup/#installing-from-source).

----

## What's changed

### LLDB regression fix

In 2026.10.22, the portable `pwndbg-lldb` failed to start with:

```
pwndbg-lldb: line 3: .../pwndbg/bin/python3: No such file or directory
```

The launcher script was changed to run `bin/python3` (#4102), but that wrapper was only added to the GDB bundle and not to the LLDB one. The LLDB bundle now includes it too ([#4268](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4268)).

### Other fixes

* `spray <addr> <length> --value <value>` now writes the value (truncated) when the length is shorter than the value; previously it wrote nothing ([#4261](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4261))
* `hexdump` no longer hides the first line of a run of identical lines that comes right after exactly two identical lines ([#4260](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4260))
* `try-free` now checks the unsorted bin the same way glibc does, so it catches the `free(): corrupted unsorted chunks` case instead of reporting "All checks passed!" ([#4262](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4262))

---

Full Changelog: https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/compare/2026.10.22...2026.10.28

Thanks also to our new contributor: @sindooo ([#4268](https://github.com/pwndbg/pwndbg/pull/4268)), who found and fixed the LLDB regression!
